description: Search available MCP tools by keyword or category before calling them. Returns names, descriptions and, on request, inputSchemas. Queries are logged 90 days, screened for credentials and personal data. Categories: data, dev, encoding, eval, integrations, llm, meta, qa, rag, security, text, web.

category.description: Optional filter, one of the categories above. Any other value is refused.

max_results.description: Maximum tools to return (default 10, max 50). Best match first.

with_schema.description: Set true to include inputSchema in results (default: false)

name: find_tool
